summary: Session 1 of 2 complete. Added three SkippableFact-gated black-box CLI test classes (CliExtractTests, CliTranslateTests, CliRunTests) under tests/AccessHarvester.Integration/Cli/ that invoke AccessHarvester.exe out-of-process via the existing CliInvoker helper and assert on exit code + --json-status envelope shape + tier-directory shape for the extract, translate, and run subcommands respectively. Full suite green on this Windows+Access host (Integration 20/20 + 1 skip for the gitignored Northwind fixture); one pre-existing failure in ParseSuccessReportTests.HomeHealthCare_parse_success_report was verified to exist on pristine origin/main and is out of scope here. Cross-provider verification VERIFIED via gemini-pro after gpt-5-4 hit a 429 (lessons-learned ladder step 2). Session 2 remains: determinism gate (run-twice-diff for parse / generate-docs / run reusing GoldenNormalizer) + PrintUsage() drift audit + closeout artifacts.

reason.specifics: Routed analysis (gemini-pro) recommends Sonnet @ effort=low for Session 2.
